no: Contributed by Clark Kimberling and Peter Moses, based on notes from Benjamin Warren, March 13-16, 2025.

In the plane of a triangle ABC, let A' be the reflection of A in X_2, and let A'' be the reflection of A' in line BC. Define B" and B" cyclically. The triangle A"B"C is here named the **Warren reflection triangle**, and its circumcircle, the **Warren reflection circle.** The vertices are given by A" = a^2 : c^2 + a^2 - b^2 : a^2 + b^2 - c^2 B" = b^2 + c^2 - a^2 : b^2 : a^2 + b^2 - c^2 C" = b^2 + c^2 - a^2 : c^2 + a^2 - b^2: c^2
Let A'''B'''C''' be the reflection of A"B"C" in X_3. Then

Along with the six points A", B", C", A''', B''',C''' on the Warren reflection circle are the points X(i) for these i: 2, 376,1106, 14916, 67625 through 67642; at total of 24 points. The Warren reflection circle has persepctor X_67624 and is given by the following equation: c^2*x*y + b^2*x*z + a^2*y*z - (x + y + z)*(((a^2 + b^2 + c^2)*x)/9 + ((a^2 + b^2 + c^2)*y)/9 + ((a^2 + b^2 + c^2)*z)/9) = 0.
Returning to the Warren reflection triangle, the point, let A"" be the reflection of A" in X_2, and define B"" and C"" cyclically. Then
The vertices A"", B"", C"" lie on the orthocentroidal circle of ABC.

For every point P on the cubic K060, A""B""C"" is perspective to the cevian triangle of P, * For every point P on the cubic K001, A""B""C"" is perspective to the anticevian triangle of P, * For every point P on the Keipert circumhyperbola, A""B""C"" is perspective to the pedal triangle of P. * For every point P on the cubic K1279, A""B""C"" is perspective to the antipedal triangle of P.

The appearance of (name, i) in the following list means that the triangle A""B""C"" is perspective to the named triangle, and the perspector is X(i): (ABC, 4) (orthic triangle, 4) (excentral triangle, 3336) (Euler triangle, 4 (circum-orthic triangle, 4) (outer Napoleon triangle, 62) (inner Napoleon triangle, 61) (half altitude triangle, 4) (4th Brocard triangle, 6) (inner Grebe triangle (see ETC X_1160), 7720) (outer Grebe triangle (see ETC X_1161), 7721) (2nd extouch triangle(see ETC X_5927), 4) (3rd extouch triangle (see ETC X_5927), 4) (3rd Hatzipolakis triangle (see ETC X_17817), 22949) (1st orthosymmedial triangle (see ETC X_6792), 4) (Artzt triangle (see ETC X_9742), 9753) (anti-1st-Euler triangle, 4) (anti-orthocentroidal triangle (see X_10293), 6) (infinite altitude triangle, 4) (2nd Hyacinth triangle #24029, X_10937 (1st excosine triangle (see X_17807), 17823 (Ehrmann vertex-triangle, 4) (anti-inner-Grebe triangle, 19043) (anti-outer-Grebe triangle, 19044) (Gemini 107 triangle, 1992) (Hatzipolakis-Moses triangle (see ETC X_6145), 32329) (1st half-squares triangle (see X_33338), 4) (2nd half-squares triangle (see X_33338), 4) (Moses-Steiner osculating triangle, 4) (orthic axis triangle (see X_2501), 4) (Brocard 9th triangle 4) (1st Altintas-isodynamic triangle (see X_41016)), 4) (2nd Altintas-isodynamic triangle (see X_41016)), 4) (1st Kenmotu-centers triangle, 44639) (2nd Kenmotu-centers triangle, 44640) (orthocentroidal-isogonic triangle, 5) (2nd anti-extouch triangle, 19361) (1st anti-Kenmotu-centers triangle, 45480) (2nd anti-Kenmotu-centers triangle, 45481)
